handoff: Changed product files: `openfisca-japan:dashboard/src/mocks/resultDetailsTestUtils.tsx` (new), `openfisca-japan:dashboard/src/components/result/resultDetails.stories.tsx` (new, title `Results/Details`, 11 stories with play functions), `openfisca-japan:dashboard/src/components/result/resultDetails.browser.test.tsx` (new, 14 tests including 2 `it.fails`). App code and protected config (`dashboard/package.json`, `.github/workflows/**`) were not changed. Upstream files contain no register IDs or links.

Ticket update still to do: writes to `docs/ja/projects/prj-0001/controls/project-register/pjr-n0fe-frontend-helpdesk-benefit-loan-tests.md` were denied in this run. Set the 4. 作業内容 table to: No1 open (memo: not measured because this base has no coverage dependency; conditions found by reading the code and config), No2 done (memo: added 11 stories and 14 Browser Mode tests, 2 of them `it.fails`), No3 open (memo: orchestrator measures and appends after the 区切り 5 PR). Write the following handoff items into 5. 対応結果.

What the stories check: BenefitAmounts (amounts rounded down to 0.1 万円 with their unit, e.g. 4321 → `0.4 万円/日` and 5000000 → `500 万円`; `1~4.5` and `0~5.3` when min and max differ; sorted by maximum amount ascending; zero amounts hidden; the opened 児童手当 panel shows its caption, detail link and the Fujimi help desk with website, map and phone links; 災害弔慰金 shows no help desk). BenefitHivPositive / BenefitHivNegative / BenefitHivUnanswered (the hepatitis C study shows the base hospital help desk only when a household member is HIV-positive; 健康管理費用 always shows it). LoanUnits / LoanOtherOnly (upper limit with monthly or one-off unit, e.g. `~15 万円/月`, `~20 万円`, `~12.3 万円`; config order; zero amounts hidden; the 生活福祉資金貸付制度 heading and the residence's social welfare council appear only when that category has a loan). BaseHospitalsTokyo / BaseHospitalsWithoutDuplicates (prefectural hospitals before regional ones; the Sendai Medical Center, on both lists, appears once). HelpDeskWithNote (a help desk's 補足事項 text appears).

What the Browser Mode tests check: the social welfare council desk for unsupported residences (prefecture without the city, and prefecture without data) shows 社会福祉協議会の調べ方 and the national list link, with no map or phone; city help desks show nothing for unsupported residences (千代田区, さいたま市); for the social welfare council, the city (児童手当) and the base hospital desks, the name links to the website when a URL exists and is plain text when the URL is blank, and the map (Google Maps search URL) and `tel:` links appear in both cases. The blank URL is set by temporarily changing the config data and restoring it after each test. Benefit and Loan render nothing when every amount is 0. Elements are found by visible text, role and name; accordion contents are searched inside the `region` named after its button; elements that appear after rendering are waited for with find…, `expect.poll` or `waitFor`.

Bug found (app code not fixed, please file it as a separate item): in `dashboard/src/config/社会福祉協議会.ts`, the `WebサイトURL` of 東京都羽村市 and 東京都利島村 holds the facility name ('羽村市社会福祉協議会' / '利島村社会福祉協議会'), not a URL. Steps: set the residence to 羽村市 or 利島村 and show the social welfare council desk (e.g. under 生活福祉資金貸付制度 in the loan results). The facility name link's href is a relative path, and clicking it goes to a non-existent page inside the app. Expected: the name links to a website (http:// or https:// URL), or is plain text when there is no URL. The two `it.fails` tests in `resultDetails.browser.test.tsx`, `does not link the facility name to a non-URL value (hamura)` and `(toshima)`, assert the correct behaviour; after the data is fixed they will fail, so change them back to `it`.

Observation (needs a decision on whether to file it): `HelpDeskTemplate` in `helpDesk.tsx` checks whether the residence has a help desk using `helloWorkData` (the job centre data) for every help desk, not the data it was passed. All current city help desk data covers only 埼玉県富士見市, so nothing changes on screen and no test can reach this (none added). If a help desk is added for a city the job centre data lacks, it will not show; if the prefecture is also missing from that data, rendering throws an error.

Observation: the social welfare council and base hospital help desks read the residence in a `useEffect` after render, so on first render a supported residence briefly shows 社会福祉協議会の調べ方. The tests check after rendering settles.

Validation to run after integration: in `dashboard`, run `npm run test`, `npm run test:ui` (Chromium), `npm run build`, `npm run lint` and `npm run pretty:check`. In this sandbox every npm, npx and node command stopped at an approval prompt, so none ran. Types and formatting were checked by reading only (Prettier widths counted full-width characters as 2). If `pretty:check` fails, `npm run pretty` should fix it.

Coverage: per the ticket's 区切り 2.5 premise, not measured in this run (neither before nor after). After the 区切り 5 PR, the orchestrator measures `helpDesk.tsx`, `benefit.tsx`, `loan.tsx` (and `loanAccordion.tsx`) and appends the numbers to the ticket.
No proposed changes to protected configuration.
